description: This file defines a template class 'BaseAdministrator' within the WPEFramework::ProcessContainers namespace. The class manages a collection of container objects, providing methods to retrieve, insert, and remove containers, and handles cleanup upon destruction.

classes.name: BaseAdministrator
classes.description: A template class managing a collection of container objects, providing thread-safe access and lifecycle management.

methods.name: ~BaseAdministrator()
methods.description: Destructor that releases all remaining containers and logs if any are still active.

methods.name: Containers()
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the container IDs.

methods.name: Get()
methods.description: Retrieves a container by its ID, increasing its reference count.

methods.name: RemoveContainer()
methods.description: Removes a specified container from the internal list; should be called only from within the container's destructor.

methods.name: InsertContainer()
methods.description: Adds a new container to the internal list; must be called with the internal lock held.
